sections.heading: Key Findings
sections.body:
More than 41,700 employers across 42 countries reported a global Net Employment Outlook (NEO) of 31% for Q2 2026, up 6 points from the previous quarter and 7 points year-over-year.

Regional Performance: Asia Pacific recorded the strongest regional outlook at 39%, improving 9 points year-over-year. Europe and the Middle East recorded an outlook of 23%.

Leading Markets: India reported the strongest hiring intentions globally at 68%, followed by the United Arab Emirates at 60% and Brazil at 55%. In Asia Pacific, Vietnam recorded 47% and Australia 33%.

Industry Demand: The Information sector led global hiring expectations at 41%, followed by Finance & Insurance at 35%.

Organisation Size: Organisations with 250-999 employees reported the strongest hiring plans at 37%, while employers with fewer than 10 employees recorded the largest year-over-year improvement, up 12 points.

Hiring Drivers: Employers planning to increase headcount pointed to company expansion, while organisations expecting reductions most often cited wider economic challenges.
